name: controle-sigen
description: Leitura simplificada do inventário bovino do SIGEN+ para o produtor rural

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @sigen/api" "npm run dev -w @sigen/web"
scripts.dev:lan: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @sigen/api" "npm run dev:lan -w @sigen/web"
scripts.dev:tailscale: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @sigen/api" "npm run dev -w @sigen/web -- --host $(tailscale ip -4)"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @sigen/api && npm run build -w @sigen/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @sigen/api && npm run test -w @sigen/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @sigen/api && npm run typecheck -w @sigen/web
